reason: A UI-focused DeepSeek Harness plugin that pins and color-codes workspaces and sessions while adding local navigation organization features such as boards, tags, saved views, health summaries, and keyword jumping.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏置顶并标记工作区和会话，同时提供本地化的看板、标签、筛选视图和快捷跳转功能。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness UI plugin for pinning and color-coding workspaces and sessions while providing local boards, tags, saved views, and quick navigation.

capabilities: Pins workspaces and sessions in the sidebar
Reorders pinned items and applies row colors
Stores pin and organizer state in settings or browser local storage
Reads public session snapshot metadata for read-only health summaries
Provides local boards, tags, saved views, and /goto navigation
